messages:
jamie (Partner Ops): Vendor Onload just alerted that marketplace API is throwing 502s for new customer signups. Can we formalize the partner escalation path for this kind of incident? Need a quick runbook and a joint war room.

sarah (Solutions Eng): I'll open a shared channel with the vendor. What do we need in the handoff checklist?

prashant (SRE): Triage first: is this traffic-related or a code regression? Whoever opens the PD incident should tag SRE and add error-rate dashboard link. Also need request_id/traces.

emily (Marketplace PM): I'll loop in the vendor PM and legal if we need external comms. Suggest: shared channel + 1-page contact matrix + daily checkpoints until resolved.

jamie (Partner Ops): Creating shared channel -> #partner-warroom-market-onload (private). warroom-bot, please add the vendor and our oncall.

warroom-bot: Created private channel #partner-warroom-market-onload and invited: jamie, sarah, prashant, emily, vendor-pm. Bridge pending.

sarah (Solutions Eng): Roles we should pin: vendor-support, vendor-eng, redwood-sre, redwood-soleng, comms-owner. Pin runbook and these quick commands:
```
# quick logs
kubectl logs -n marketplace -l app=api --tail=200
# healthcheck
curl -v https://marketplace.redwood.ai/health
```

prashant (SRE): Oncall rota: primary = @prashant, secondary = @kevin. PagerDuty: trigger if 5%+ HTTP 5xx for 15m. PD run: https://pd.example.com/rules/marketplace

emily (Marketplace PM): Communication rules: all outward comms go through vendor PM + Redwood comms lead (jamie). No public messaging without legal signoff. Use the channel for async updates; use bridge for live debugging. :loudspeaker:

jamie (Partner Ops): Proposed escalation signal lifecycle: 1) PD alert -> 2) shared channel + war room -> 3) live bridge if > 15m unresolved or customer-impacting -> 4) rollback/canary if release suspected -> 5) postmortem owner assigned.

sarah (Solutions Eng): I'll pin a checklist: what to collect for handoff — request_id, trace_id, user_id, payload, recent successful request ids, timestamps. Also add partner contact matrix.

prashant (SRE): If we need deeper debug, ask vendor for SFTP upload of full debug logs. For immediate triage grab these: error logs, gateway traces, egress latencies. If rate-limited, capture sample cURL with headers.

warroom-bot: Conference bridge created: https://meet.example.com/room123 (recording disabled).

jamie (Partner Ops): Handoff complete signal: vendor lead + redwood-sre reaction :white_check_mark:. Once both react, we move to monitoring mode.

sarah (Solutions Eng): :white_check_mark: vendor lead confirmed. wrapping up initial war room. Scheduling 48h follow-up checkpoint.

prashant (SRE): We'll add a 'partner-sev' template to the incident commander runbook so next time setup is faster.

emily (Marketplace PM): Thanks team — I'll keep the partner PM updated and share postmortem owner after the incident closes.
